summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting ongoing share repurchases under a buyback program announced February 4, 2026. Between June 11-17, 2026, the bank repurchased 10,708,137 shares across XMAD and CEUX venues at weighted average prices ranging from €10.5131 to €11.7919. Cumulative purchases total €3,376,585,780, representing 67.1% of the maximum investment amount and 17.2% of outstanding shares. The buyback is executed under EU Market Abuse Regulation. The cash-based tender reduces equity overhang and signals management's view of undervaluation. Watch for program completion timelines and impact on EPS.
